headline: Peru Growth Risk Seen Slowing to 2% If El Niño Phenomenon Persists
summary: Peru's economic growth could slow to 2% in 2027 in a worst-case scenario if El Niño lingers, with ENFEN forecasting the climate event to last until June 2027.
why: El Niño weather disruptions severely impact key sectors like agriculture, fishing, and mining, which drive economic performance in Andean nations.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Prolonged weather shocks pose downside risks to aggregate economic output.
